subunit.text: Component of the RSF-1 ISWI chromatin-remodeling complex at least composed of SMARCA1 and RSF1 (PubMed:28801535). Within the RSF-1 ISWI chromatin-remodeling complex interacts with SMARCA1 (PubMed:28801535). Component of the RSF-5 ISWI chromatin-remodeling complex (also called the RSF complex) at least composed of SMARCA5/SNF2H and RSF1 (PubMed:12972596, PubMed:28801535). Within the RSF-5 ISWI chromatin-remodeling complex interacts with SMARCA5/SNF2H; the interaction is direct (PubMed:12972596, PubMed:28801535). Identified in a centromere complex containing histones H2A, H2B and H4, and at least CENPA, CENPB, CENPC, CENPT, CENPN, HJURP, SUPT16H, SSRP1 and RSF1 (PubMed:27499292). Also binds the HBV pX/HBx protein, which is required to activate transcription of the viral genome (PubMed:11788598, PubMed:11944984)
